name: lain
description: Desktop Browser Shell with Terminal and Local AI

scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run dev:vite" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const bases=['darwin-arm64','darwin-x64']; for(const b of bases){const p=path.join(process.cwd(),'node_modules','node-pty','prebuilds',b,'spawn-helper'); if(fs.existsSync(p)) { try { fs.chmodSync(p,0o755); } catch(e){} }}"
